problems.quote: The physical basis of segregation is the separation of sister chromatids at anaphase II
problems.problem: Incorrectly identifies sister chromatid separation at anaphase II as the physical basis of Mendelian segregation; the basis is homologous chromosome separation at anaphase I.
problems.correction: The physical basis of segregation is the separation of homologous chromosomes at anaphase I
problems.verifierReason: Mendelian segregation separates alleles on homologous chromosomes, which occurs at anaphase I, not sister chromatids at anaphase II.

problems.quote: The early atmosphere was reducing (CH4, NH3, H2, H2O), lacking free oxygen.
problems.problem: Current geochemical evidence indicates the early atmosphere was likely neutral (CO2, N2, H2O) rather than strongly reducing; CH4 and NH3 were minor or absent.
problems.correction: The early atmosphere was likely neutral (CO2, N2, H2O), lacking free oxygen.
problems.verifierReason: Original reflects outdated reducing atmosphere model; current consensus is neutral (CO2, N2, H2O). Correction accurate.

problems.quote: Subsequent variations produced sugars, nitrogenous bases, and ATP.
problems.problem: Miller-Urey type experiments produced amino acids, sugars, and nitrogenous bases, but not ATP; prebiotic synthesis of ATP is a separate unsolved challenge.
problems.correction: Subsequent variations produced sugars and nitrogenous bases.
problems.verifierReason: Miller-Urey variations did not produce ATP; prebiotic ATP synthesis remains unsolved. Correction removes erroneous claim.

problems.problem: The Human Genome Project's original goal was to identify all human genes (then estimated at ~100,000); the ~20,000-25,000 figure is the actual count discovered later, not the target.
problems.correction: Goals included identifying all human genes
problems.verifierReason: HGP's goal was to identify all human genes, not a specific count; ~20k-25k is actual count found later. Correction accurate.
